description:
At Do It Tennis, our commitment to our customers is simple:

Help tennis players around the globe find the perfect products for their level and style of play at great prices while receiving outstanding customer service.

Do It Tennis is based in the city of San Marcos and is located in San Diego County, CA. We began Internet operations in March 2005. Our knowledgeable staff has extensive experience in the tennis industry and all our stringers are highly experienced and expert at their craft.

DoItTennis.com Affiliate Terms & Conditions

Please read our affiliate terms and conditions carefully before you join our program or begin promoting it. These terms are written in plain language to ensure they are easily understood and followed. Adhering to these terms ensures the DoItTennis.com Affiliate Program remains sustainable and profitable for both you (the affiliate) and us.

Definitions

As used in these Terms:

  • “We”, “us”, or “our” refers to DoItTennis.com
  • “You” or “your” refers to the Affiliate
  • “Our website” refers to the DoItTennis.com website located at www.DoItTennis.com
  • “Your website” refers to any site that links to our website
  • “Program” refers to the DoItTennis.com Affiliate Program

Coupon Guidelines

If you promote coupon codes, you must adhere to the following:

  • You may ONLY advertise coupon codes provided directly through the affiliate program or network.
  • You may NOT advertise coupon codes from:
  • Non-affiliate advertising
  • Customer emails
  • Paid search
  • Any other marketing campaigns
  • Violation of these terms may result in:
  • Removal from the affiliate program
  • Reversal of sales
  • Reduction in commissions

PPC Guidelines

If you participate in PPC (Pay-Per-Click) advertising, you must comply with the following:

  • Do NOT bid on any of our trademarked terms (or variations/misspellings) in any search or content-based campaigns (e.g., Google, MSN, Yahoo).
  • Do NOT use our trademarked terms in sequence with any other keyword (e.g., “DoItTennis.com Coupons”).
  • Do NOT direct link to our website from a PPC ad or use redirects that result in the same.
  • Affiliates must link to an actual page on their own website.
  • If using automation, it’s your responsibility to exclude our trademarked terms and add them as negative keywords.

Violation of these PPC guidelines will result in all current and past commissions being set to 0% without warning.

Trademarked Terms:

  • DoItTennis.com
  • Do It Tennis
  • DoItTennis
  • www.doittennis.com

Domain Names

You may not use our trademarked terms as part of your domain or sub-domain (e.g., doittennis.website.com or www.website.com/doittennis).

Email Campaigns

If you promote the program via email:

  • You must comply with the CAN-SPAM Act of 2003 (Public Law No. 108-187).
  • Emails must be sent on your behalf, not as if from DoItTennis.com.
  • All email content must be submitted for approval before sending.

Nexus Affiliate Restrictions

We are unable to work with resident affiliates in the following states if solicitation activities go beyond passive website linking:

  • New York
  • North Carolina
  • Pennsylvania
  • Rhode Island

As a condition of participation, affiliates agree not to conduct solicitation activities in the above states, which includes:

  • Distributing flyers, coupons, newsletters, or similar promotional materials
  • Engaging in verbal or in-person solicitation
  • Initiating phone calls or sending emails referring customers to DoItTennis.com

Affiliates may be required to provide annual affidavits certifying they are not conducting prohibited activities in these states.
